Hi Emma — thanks for the request. I've summarized what we can provide and how the controls map to your checklist. Below is an operational summary and the specific artifacts we will deliver.

Operational summary (short):
- No-training flag: Customers can enable a "no-train" configuration on their workspace. When enabled, no telemetry, prompts, or responses are used in model training pipelines or shared to model improvement services.
- Prompt/response storage: For hosted sessions we keep in-memory KV caches during active sessions. Prompts and responses are written to ephemeral logs with a default TTL of 72 hours (configurable down to 0 hours for strict customers). After TTL expiry logs are purged automatically; persistent backups are not created for no-train workspaces.
- Redaction and minimization: PII fields matched by customer-provided regexes or our built-in PII detectors are redacted before any persistent snapshot.
- Erasure workflow: Verified erasure requests are processed via our privacy API (internal ticket + audit). Standard SLA is 10 business days for full material exclusion from logs/indexes and 30 business days for downstream backups if applicable.

Artifacts we will deliver (timeline in parentheses):
- Signed attestation: "Redwood No-Train & Ephemeral Storage" (PDF) — 2 business days.
- Sample log export: single-session JSONL with redactions applied (sample_log_snippet.jsonl) — 2 business days.
- Erasure playbook: step-by-step internal runbook + API endpoints for entitlement checks (text) — 3 business days.
- Audit trace: example audit log showing an erasure request and completion event (anonymized) — 5 business days.

Delivery options: secure Drive link (preferred), SFTP, or uploaded to a PRD workspace. We'll also provide a short 30-minute walkthrough if you'd like.

I've attached the proposed attestation template as a draft and linked it into our shared folder.

Monica Patel
Director, Privacy & Trust | Redwood Inference
